The '''Tempered Wastes''' were a [[Star/Legends|stellar]]-poor stretch of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], west of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|core]]. The [[Lehon system]]&mdash;home to the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Planet/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]], also known as Rakata Prime&mdash;was located within it.<ref name="TEA" />
